subject: Scheduling: legal + procurement review for Acme Health redlines
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acmehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyanka Suri <psuri@acmehealth.com>, legal@acmehealth.com
Date: 2027-06-02T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft redlines - request for a focused review meeting

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks for sending the draft back so quickly. Our procurement and legal teams reviewed the PDF and we have a set of tracked changes and a few gating questions around data handling (retention windows) and subprocessor flow-down. Rather than a long email thread, can we set up a focused 45-minute meeting with legal + procurement + technical SE to walk through the redlines and identify deal-critical items?

Must-haves for us: someone from Redwood who can speak to runtime isolation and KMS/HSM options, and the expected timeline if we need an on-prem package. I attached the annotated PDF (Acme_Redlines_v4.pdf).

Available windows for our side next week (PST): Tue 6/8 10–12, Wed 6/9 14–16. If those don't work, propose 2 alternative slots.

Jordan
Acme Health — Sr. Manager, Procurement

Attachment: Acme_Redlines_v4.pdf (annotated)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, legal@acmehealth.com
Date: 2027-06-02T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft redlines - request for a focused review meeting

Jordan — thanks, this makes sense. Happy to coordinate.

Quick notes:
- I can represent legal/contract side for Redwood and loop Markus for any exec approvals if we hit a term that needs patching.
- Aditya (SE) will cover runtime isolation, KMS, and on-prem options.
- Lauren (finance/procurement) will help align on billing and SOW cadence.

Proposed slots from our side (PST):
- Tue 6/8 10:30–11:15 (30–45 min) — Marissa/Aditya/Me available
- Wed 6/9 15:00–15:45 — also possible, but Markus is limited at that time

If neither works, Marissa can run an availability poll. Also fine with extending to 60 minutes if folks prefer a walk-through plus Q&A.

Agenda suggestion (short):
1) Quick intros & scope (5 min)
2) Walk redlines that affect data flows and retention (20–25 min)
3) Operational options and timeline (10 min)
4) Action items and next steps (5–10 min)

Let me know which slot works and any additional attendees we should add.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Counsel, Contracts — Redwood Inference

Attachment: MAPS-stub-kpis.xlsx (billing stub, optional)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acmehealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-02T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft redlines - request for a focused review meeting

Jordan — appreciated. I'll send a calendar invite for Tue 6/8 10:30–11:15 PST (45m) unless you tell me otherwise by EOD.

Small asks for the meeting: please have the legal redline author on the call (so we can run through tracked edits live). If you expect to cover SSO/JIT provisioning, add your identity engineer.

If anyone from Acme needs a separate session with our Security team, we can schedule that in the same week — happy to coordinate after the redline walk.

Marissa
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Thanks all — quick update from our side. The procurement lead who needs to join (Anita Rao) is unexpectedly on travel Tue morning and can't make 10:30. Can we move to Wed 6/9 15:00–16:00? That slot works best for procurement + legal.

Also: can Redwood confirm a short pre-read (1 page) that highlights the top 4 redline items we're planning to discuss? That will help the legal team prioritize.

Priyanka Suri
Director, Procurement — Acme Health

Attachment: (none)

Date: 2027-06-03T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed — Wed 6/9 15:00–16:00 PST (contract redline review)

Thanks for the update, Priyanka — Wed 6/9 15:00–16:00 PST works for us. I updated the invite to 60 minutes to give room for the walk-through and Q&A.

Per Priyanka's ask, attached is a 1-page pre-read that calls out the top four redline areas: data retention, subprocessors, indemnity carve-outs, and audit access. Aditya will take the tech portion; I'll cover contract language and escalation paths. Markus is on standby if we need leadership alignment post-call.

Agenda (final):
- 15:00 Intro & objective (5m)
- 15:05 Redline walkthrough: Legal items (25m)
- 15:30 Technical + security implications (15m)
- 15:45 Next steps & ownership (15m)

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=acme-redline-20270609

See you all on Wed.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Contracts — Redwood Inference
